semanticOwners.quotaConsumptionFact: named action or Measured Fact owner

separationLaw: Quota and wallet are distinct typed families. Neither is a scalar balance or a universal Held Position algebra.

quota.unitLaw: A policy binds one bounded featureCode and one indivisible unitCode; quantities are non-negative checked int64 quanta. Currency codes are forbidden.

variants.reset: Append WindowOpened for the successor window; never mutate or erase the predecessor
variants.reservationOrder: Compare-bind exact capacityGeneration; append reservation before returning Accepted
variants.consumeOrder: Consume exactly one active reservation with the same semantic operation identity
variants.releaseOrder: Release only an active reservation after non-occurrence is proven or the caller explicitly abandons before any possible external effect
variants.contention: Serializable compare-bind per subject/feature/window/unit/policy generation; insufficient remainder admits at most one contender
variants.uncertainty: Return Indeterminate with durable residue; retain the exact reservation
variants.correction: Append typed CapacityAdjustment or Restitution in the original window; a closed-window adjustment never rewrites history and never silently carries forward

variants.rollover: At successor WindowOpened, append a non-negative CarryForward adjustment capped by carryForwardCap; source-window remainder and target adjustment are lineage-linked
variants.uncertainty: Indeterminate with retained reservation and residue
variants.correction: Append source correction; if carry-forward was already derived, append a lineage-linked successor correction in the target window

window.identity: evaluationInstant plus ordered contributing bucket generations

variants.reset: Capacity expires only as contributing buckets leave the window; expiration is appended
variants.reservationOrder: Compare-bind the complete contributing-bucket generation vector
variants.contention: Serializable compare-bind over subject/feature/unit and contributing buckets
variants.uncertainty: Indeterminate with retained reservation and residue
variants.correction: Append to the original event bucket; recompute later projections without rewriting prior decisions

wallet.quantityLaw: A wallet and every lot bind exactly one unit kind. Monetary wallets bind one ISO-4217 currency and integer minor-unit exponent; non-monetary wallets bind one bounded unitCode and forbid currency. Cross-unit or cross-currency arithmetic is rejected.
eligibilityOrder: not expired at reservation effective time

variants.expiry: Reservation pins eligibility. A reservation accepted before expiry is grandfathered through its bounded reservation deadline; unused remainder expires by appended LotExpired after the deadline.
variants.partialConsumption: Allowed; plan contains deterministic positive source slices whose sum equals requested quantity and preserves remainder per lot
variants.correction: Append a typed correction referencing the consumption and exact source slices; never edit or negate the original
variants.recredit: Append new origin-linked lots, one per corrected source provenance class, preserving paid/promotional, target, restriction and unit attributes; recredit time is new origin time and expiry is recalculated by explicit reason policy
variants.transfer: Append paired source consumption and destination origin lots with one transferId; same unit/currency only; both endpoint guards required or durable prepare/fence with Indeterminate residue
variants.residue: Ineligible/expired/unknown lots, insufficient eligible quantity, partial transfer, and uncertain external effect remain explicit; no scalar remainder hides them

variants.expiry: Accepted reservation is grandfathered through its bounded deadline; otherwise expired lots are ineligible and LotExpired is appended
Any source lot crossing expiry before consumption invalidates the whole plan with ReplanRequired; append expiries, release only proven-unused reservations, and compute a new plan
variants.partialConsumption: Allowed only within one admitted plan; no partial admission after a stale plan is detected
variants.residue: Uncertain possible-send reservations remain held; stale plan is visible

invalidCombinations.rule: wallet monetary lots have different currency or minor-unit exponent
wallet non-monetary lots have different unitCode
quota rollover is enabled for rolling windows
fail-open quota admission or projection/alert used as consumption
wallet policy mixes grandfather and force-replan expiry within one reservation
wallet transfer changes unit/currency or omits either endpoint guard
unknown policy revision or discriminator is defaulted
negative quantity, unchecked overflow, saturation, or lossy conversion
quota and wallet share one balance, reservation, correction, or persistence discriminator

migration.readerRule: Readers accept only an explicitly declared compatible schema and policy revision range; unknown variants are preserved and quarantined.
migration.representationEquivalent: Requires golden byte/canonical-vector evidence and retains original bytes and digest.
migration.semanticChange: Creates a successor policy revision and generation with typed lineage; existing reservations and facts remain governed by their pinned revision.
migration.inFlight: Never reinterpret. Complete under the pinned revision, or append a governed replan/replacement that references the original and retains residue.
migration.legacyWalletBalance: Import only as explicit opening lots with known provenance; irreconstructible composition becomes bounded migration residue and cannot be claimed as lots.
migration.legacyQuota: Import an explicit opening window/capacity generation and source evidence; ambiguous window consumption remains residue.

acceptance.note: Acceptance is external to this self-digesting file and must record exact artifact digests.
